name: createos
description: NodeOps CreateOS plugins — disposable sandbox compute for Claude Code, Codex, and more.

plugins.name: createos-sandbox
plugins.description: Run ad-hoc/heavy/untrusted code in disposable CreateOS Sandboxes; offload, parallel fanout, scratch shell, reusable box with sync, port tunnel, public expose, network clusters, S3 disks, WireGuard VPN, fork, pause/resume, and custom images.

plugins.name: createos-sandbox-codex
plugins.description: Codex plugin for disposable CreateOS Sandboxes — the `cos` driver, the using-createos-sandbox skill, and session-start / offload-hint hooks. Same engine as the Claude Code plugin.
